messages.subject: Adding internal nodes to facet_plot
parts:
Hi all,


I wonder if there is any way to associate data with internal nodes of a phylogenetic tree in addition to its tips as in function `facet_plot`.


The possible solution may be to introduce additional tips corresponding to the internal nodes, thus making the tree ternary:


```

library(ggtree)


tr <- read.tree(text='(((Tip1,NodeA,Tip2),((Tip3,NodeB,Tip4),Tip5,NodeC),NodeD), Tip6, NodeE);')

p <- ggtree(tr) + geom_tiplab(align=TRUE) + xlim_tree(5)


png('tip_node_plot.png', 640, 640)

plot(p)

dev.off()

```


An example of the produced figure is attached.


However, this solution has two drawbacks: first, internal nodes can be shown on the top or the bottom of the subtree instead of being in the middle (for example, NodeD); second, lines from internal tips to the corresponding nodes might be broken (for example, NodeC).


Best regards,

Gaik
